name: Twelve Tools

sources.title: Submit your Website — Free $0 (1 dofollow link, 72h review, backlink required) vs Pro $36 one-time ($25.20 with FROGDR)
Homepage — 'Twelve new tools a day', curated directory
Badge page — badges required for the free tier

conditions: Free listing requires placing a Twelve Tools backlink/badge on your homepage or footer
Free tier is reviewed within 72 hours and gives 1 dofollow link — no homepage featuring
Pro ($36 one-time, $25.20 with auto-applied FROGDR code) removes the backlink requirement, reviews within 24h, gives 3 dofollow links and homepage featuring
requirements: A live website/tool to submit (general directory — 140+ categories)
For free tier: ability to embed the badge/backlink on your homepage or footer
Stripe checkout for the Pro tier
preparation: Website URL, name, description, category choice
Badge code snippet for the free route (badges shown on the submit page)
Decide free-with-backlink vs $36 Pro (FROGDR coupon auto-applied at checkout)
workflow: Free route: install the backlink/badge before or as part of submission, wait up to 72h for review
Pro route: pay via Stripe (FROGDR code pre-applied → $25.20), listed within 24h with homepage featuring
watchFor: Free tier's backlink is mandatory and presumably verified — removing it risks delisting
FROGDR 30% coupon is pre-applied at checkout — the 'real' price is effectively $25.20, not $36
Free tier gets only 1 dofollow link vs 3 for Pro — category/tag choices may matter
Site is part of a maker network (Ramen Tools, Wired Business, FrogDR, 500.Tools) — expect cross-promotion
countsAsLive: Tool appears with a public page in its category listing at twelve.tools/c/<category> and the outbound link is dofollow
unknowns: Exact fields on /submit-your-tool (the plan picker page itself is the public part)
Whether the free-tier backlink is checked automatically
Rejection/refund policy if a submission is declined
